verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a real error-search query syntax with tag filters and negation (`-tag:wip`), field qualifiers such as class, component and action, and metadata search. It also searches across all projects, filters by deploy time with `occurred.after:'last deploy'`, and offers BadgerQL for filtering Insights events. However, the evidence does not show an environment filter, filtering by a specific release or revision value, or arbitrary custom-property syntax beyond a general mention of meta-data, so story coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: an explicit environment filter qualifier, release/revision-specific filtering (beyond deploy-time recency), documented custom-property query syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and filter events across projects by tag, release, environment, and custom properties with a real query syntax

citations.quote: You can search for errors in a single project, or across all projects.
find previously-occurred errors by type, location, meta-data and many other attributes
filter the kinds of events that should be returned, perform aggregations and calculations, and more
